theme: HMLR boundary and title-plan precision controls
verified_controls: legal boundary is an exact line but is rarely identified precisely
physical boundary is not automatically the legal boundary
most registered titles use general boundaries
no standard tolerance measurement or ratio links a general title-plan boundary to the legal boundary
title plan shows general extent and must be read with the register
title plans show general boundaries unless determined under section 60
determined-boundary route is the precision escalation path
boundary agreement is a separate precision/evidence route
Ordnance Survey feature line is not itself a legal boundary
INSPIRE geometry remains candidate extent not legal-boundary proof
parcel height result cannot be promoted from title-plan geometry alone
